messages:
alex: Quick RFC: add per-model-variant affinity + estimated cache-savings to the cost preview panel. Goal: let PMs see which variants tank unit-econ before a rollout. Low-ingest variant: sampled telemetry -> weighted rollups.

priya: 👍 useful. Important: how do we present uncertainty? If it's sampled we should surface CI or a fuzzy badge.

dana: Implementation thought: two-tier sampling. 1) critical billing routes = 100% capture. 2) all others: adaptive reservoir sampling per-minute where sample rate = min(1%, f(traffic, model_priority)). This lets high-volume but low-priority routes still get some representation.

lucas: Reservoir per-minute is nice since model churn can change quickly. But we need to export sample_rate with each event so infra can unbias counts. Also we should include route_policy and cohort tags (eg "sticky_v2") so we can attribute routing-induced cost shifts.

alex: Sample event proto (inline):
```json
{
  "ts":1720000000,
  "route":"r_customer_chat",
  "model":"rw-2.0",
  "variant":"fp16-a",
  "tokens_out": 320,
  "tokens_in": 45,
  "cache_hit": false,
  "cache_savings": 0,
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "route_policy": "sticky_v2",
  "cohort": "beta-tenant"
}
```
(we don't need raw prompt text in telemetry)

priya: Console UX: cost preview card shows two toggles: "Estimated (sampled)" vs "Exact (100% routes)" and "Show cache savings". For sampled, show a small tooltip: "estimate based on X% sampled telemetry, 90% CI". Also an export button that includes sample info for audit.

dana: Storage calc: if global 5k rps and 0.5% avg sample => ~2.16M events/day. If we store compact counters at ingest (hour+route+model+variant+cache_hit) we can drop raw retention to 7 days and keep rollups for 365 days.

lucas: Ingest plan: sampled events write to a fast aggregator (increment counters) rather than S3. Keep raw trace only for 100% routes and a small reservoir for anomalies. Aggregator stores: hour, route, model, variant, cache_hit, sum_tokens_in_weighted, sum_tokens_out_weighted, count_weighted, sample_sum_inv. Use sum of 1/sample_rate weighting to estimate effective count.

alex: Good note on anomalies. Also we need an explainability field: "routing_hint_before" / "routing_hint_after" for any rollout so the card can show delta caused by routing change vs model change. Maybe attach rollout_id when available.

infra-bot: CI: telemetry-schema/v3 draft pushed to staging (1720000120). Aggregator prototype running on small shard.

priya: Security/perm: expose model-level rows only to users with "econ:variant_inspect" permission. Default org-viewers see aggregated tenant-level cost only. Add a feature flag for customer-owned deployments to suppress model variant names.

dana: QA ask: billing team wants a reproducible reconciliation between weighted estimates and invoice numbers. We'll need a validation job that runs daily over a 7-day window comparing weighted sums vs full-capture ground truth for selected tenants.

lucas: Edgecases: multi-layer caches (edge+global) -> we should send cache_layer enum and raw saved_tokens per-layer if available. If not, send combined cache_savings but mark provenance="combined".

alex: Action list: (1) i'll open RFC with schema + aggregator pseudocode + permissioning section; (2) lucas to wire aggregator prototype metrics and daily validation job; (3) priya to mock UI variants and CI badge; (4) dana to simulate ingest costs for sampling curves. I'll tag billing & product in RFC.
